```{r, echo=F, results='asis'}
library(fs)
library(yaml)

# List all .qmd files in the directory (excluding this index file)
files <- dir_ls(path = ".", glob = "*.pdf")
files <- files[basename(files) != "index.qmd"]

# Output Markdown links using titles
for (file in files) {

  cat("[", file, "](", file, ")\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
